definition: The training/induction procedure does not converge, or errors, within the frozen hyperparameter range and compute budget
detection_rule: Training procedure returns a non-convergence flag, or exceeds the frozen per-fit compute budget (GRAMMAR_COMPLEXITY_CONTRACT.md)
disposition: Retain the (model_class, hyperparameter point, transcription, partition) row with status=TRAINING_FAILED and the budget/iteration count used; excluded from all comparison tables but never deleted from the job ledger

definition: The fitted model defines acceptance/likelihood but no deterministic-given-seed sampling procedure (e.g. an M3 automaton with no frozen tie-break rule)
detection_rule: The generation_algorithm step cannot deterministically complete a full TOKEN/sequence given a seed
disposition: Retain with status=NON_GENERATIVE; may later be paired with a frozen tie-break addendum, but that addendum is registered as a new model_id, never a silent edit of the failed row

definition: Log-likelihood or transition-probability computations under/overflow, or collapse to 0/1 such that a nontrivial share of VALIDATION tokens get an undefined (-inf/NaN) log-likelihood
detection_rule: Fraction of VALIDATION tokens with -inf/NaN log-likelihood exceeds a frozen threshold (frozen in GRAMMAR_VALIDATION_CONTRACT.md before any fitting)
disposition: Retain with status=NUMERICALLY_UNSTABLE and the observed fraction; a re-parameterized fix is registered as a new model_id

definition: Held-out predictive performance is statistically indistinguishable from the B1 unigram baseline, or the model assigns near-zero probability to nearly all HELDOUT data
detection_rule: PM1/PM2 improvement over B1 is not significant under the frozen VALIDATION-stage test (GRAMMAR_VALIDATION_CONTRACT.md)
disposition: Retain with status=HELDOUT_DEGENERATE; this is itself a valid negative scientific result (task85 section 43) and remains listed

definition: The complexity measure grows without an asymptotic bound as DEVELOPMENT data increases, indicating memorization rather than compact structure
detection_rule: Complexity-vs-data-size slope on nested DEVELOPMENT subsamples exceeds a frozen threshold (GRAMMAR_COMPLEXITY_CONTRACT.md)
disposition: Retain with status=COMPLEXITY_UNBOUNDED; ineligible for the G_min argmin (task85 section 30) but remains listed

definition: The model reproduces DEVELOPMENT near-perfectly but generalizes poorly, or its parameter/lexicon count approaches the DEVELOPMENT TOKEN/type count
detection_rule: Train-vs-heldout performance gap exceeds the frozen overfitting-control threshold (task85 section 32), combined with a frozen parameter-to-data-size ratio
disposition: Retain with status=MEMORIZATION_DOMINATED and both diagnostic values; ineligible for G_min

definition: The model passes the PRIMARY predictive gates (GRAMMAR_METRIC_REGISTRY.tsv) but fails the frozen family-level generative/structural gate (GRAMMAR_VALIDATION_CONTRACT.md, GRAMMAR_F2_APPLICABILITY.tsv generation-applicable subset)
detection_rule: Family-level success gate, frozen before Task86, not met on the GENERATION_APPLICABLE, non-skeleton-only F2 family subset
disposition: Retain with status=STRUCTURAL_VALIDATION_FAILED; this is a distinct, first-class scientific outcome (task85 section 43: "grammar predicts local structure but not manuscript hierarchy") and remains listed, never merged into a generic "failed" bucket
